formula.nonprefill_component_s: historical median incremental wall minus observed first 512-prefix prefill timestamp

limitations: No 8192-token HF timing exists. Scaling from one 512-token prefill timestamp is a scenario, not a measured speed or guaranteed bound.
The scaling exponent spans linear to quadratic prompt-length behavior; 1.5 is an interpolation only.
The non-prefill decode/teacher-forcing cost is held at the historical 512-prefix median residual; longer-context decode may be slower and exceed the high scenario.
The 7200-second timeout is a hard process limit, not a forecast bound; timeout means stop and do not continue the HF queue.
X TT wall time is not used as an HF speed proxy. No HF model load or run was performed.
